parsed.post: Discarded DEPTH=8 (1.0813). It seems increasing depth without adjusting LR or ASPECT_RATIO leads to under-training within the 5-minute budget. Reverting to my best (commit 73cc28f, 1.0171). Next, I'll attempt to increase MATRIX_LR more aggressively to find a better convergence point for DEPTH=6.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.08 at DEPTH=6 to improve convergence speed within the 5-minute window.
